title: 把未来交给海风
art_direction: A spacious summer sunset by a quiet Japanese coastal village. The same fictional adult couple sit side by side on a low broad stone seawall, viewed from a relaxed rear three-quarter angle. Their silhouettes are clearly distinct; the woman's head rests gently on the man's near shoulder, and their two adjacent hands meet loosely on top of the stone between them. Woman wears an opaque ivory short-sleeve cotton blouse and a muted terracotta midi skirt; man wears a slate-blue linen shirt and dark trousers. A small ochre scarf tied to her canvas bag lifts slightly in the ocean breeze. The couple occupy the lower-center third, large enough to feel present, with unbroken luminous sea and an expansive pale apricot sky around them. Fine waves, a distant tiny lighthouse at far left, one warm path of reflected sunlight, a few windblown grasses in a near corner. The horizon sits slightly above mid-height. Convey a quiet unspoken decision to share a future through closeness and a wide open view. Safe seated posture, no precipice, no dramatic cliff.

inspiration.use: Abstract themes of lasting commitment and everyday companionship; original composition and fictional characters, no lyrics rendered.

checked: Readable caring gestures and adult characters
Natural integration and plausible visible anatomy
No visible text, logo or watermark
